meta_description: MCC Electrical Services NE Ltd, Newcastle. Domestic and commercial electrical work. Local, reliable, fully qualified. Call 07951 602817 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault in Newcastle? We attend emergencies the same day, with parts carried on the van.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle every type of electrical work for homes and businesses.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Trip switches, blown fuses, socket faults, and broken lights — diagnosed and fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van to get you back to normal the same day.

services.title: Boiler and Heating Controls
services.desc: Installation and repair of electric heating systems, immersion heaters, and smart thermostats. We ensure efficient, reliable heat with full certification.

services.title: New Installations and Extensions
services.desc: Adding sockets, lighting circuits, or entire electrical systems to new builds and extensions. All work meets Part P Building Regulations with certification provided.

services.title: Rewiring and Upgrades
services.desc: Old wiring posing a fire risk? We replace aged consumer units, rewire properties, and upgrade fuse boxes to modern safety standards.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Shop fittings, office wiring, and workplace electrics. We understand deadlines and minimise disruption to your business.

services.title: Periodic Testing and Inspections
services.desc: EICR (electrical installation condition reports) for landlords, employers, and home sellers. We test, report, and recommend remedial work.

about_pullquote: We treat every job as if it were our own home — no shortcuts, no surprises on the bill.
about_para_1: MCC Electrical Services has been serving Newcastle and the surrounding area since 2008. Founded by electricians who got tired of seeing customers overcharged and let down by unreliable tradespeople, we built the business on a simple promise: fair pricing, fast response, and work you can trust. Every member of our team is fully qualified and insured.
about_para_2: Hundreds of Newcastle homeowners and business owners have relied on us for emergencies, refurbishments, and new builds. We're known for turning up on time, explaining what's wrong in plain English, and giving honest advice — not upselling work you don't need. If something goes wrong, we put it right. That's why our customers come back and recommend us to their friends.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with an electrical fault just before Christmas — the lights kept cutting out. Called MCC on the recommendation of my sister and they came out the same afternoon. Really quick diagnosis, reasonable price, and the lad knew exactly what he was doing. Brilliant. Will use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: We needed the office rewired ahead of a lease inspection. They worked around our hours, were professional and tidy, and the whole job was done in a week. Best part — they explained everything and didn't charge us for work we didn't actually need. Rare these days!
reviews.author: Helen C.

reviews.text: Emergency call-out for a tripped consumer unit — we were in the dark. They answered the phone instantly, arrived within 50 minutes, and had us back up and running in about an hour. Very fair price. Definitely keeping their number.
reviews.author: David M.
